summary: Provin Mountain tower in Massachusetts: built 1959 to replace a 1920 tower, unstaffed by 2016, on private land beside a radio site. Staffing end date and any fires not found.

facts.design: 70-foot steel tower with a 10-by-10-foot wooden cab

access.note: On private property beside an active radio transmission facility; the register says hiking to it means trespassing; a 2024 write-up says the official trail passes it and visiting without prior permission is discouraged

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register gives a 70-foot steel tower; the 2024 Trailspotting write-up gives 68 feet. The story reports the register figure and notes the difference.
The 2016 register visit report describes a boarded hatch and cracked stairs; the 2024 write-up calls it in good condition. Both are reported with their dates.

The register says a hike to the site means trespassing; Trailspotting says the official trail passes the tower and it saw no signs banning access. The story treats the site as private land and advises against climbing.

notes_for_editor: Good on the 1959 tower, the 2016 and 2024 condition reports and the access situation. Missing: when staffing ended, whether it ever spotted a notable fire, and who built the 1959 tower. Forest Fire Lookout Association Massachusetts Facebook posts (about the 1920 tower and a 2017 roof replacement) could not be read, so they are not used. Recommend a Massachusetts local-history search for Bureau staffing records. Access is private land; the story advises against climbing. No photos recorded because license terms were not clear.
